answer: Each new identity must be mirrored by an established agent who co-signs its admission and locks a matching bond beside it, so a willow of trust grows only through real sponsors. The bond loses a fixed delta of value each epoch unless the newcomer completes verified useful work, so idle clones bleed their sponsor dry. A sponsor may mirror at most three newcomers, and if one is caught faking, all three bonds burn together. A farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand real sponsors, each losing money on idle fakes, while one honest agent needs a single mirror and a single season of work.
